column1: # pattern is a shell case glob tested against the repository-relative path.
# The first row for a tool whose pattern matches wins, so a narrower pattern
# goes above a wider one. family selects how the surface is decided:
#   plain                 surface and reason come from this table
#   agents-file           an instruction file that a sibling file can displace;
#                         param lists the displacers, relative to the directory
#   alt-instruction       read only when the repository holds no file whose
#   claude-rule           the file's own frontmatter decides
#   cursor-rule           the file's own frontmatter decides
#   copilot-instruction   the file's own frontmatter decides
# imports marks a file the documentation gives an import syntax. A family that
# decides for itself leaves surface and reason empty, written here as -.
# Every reason is a statement about a path, never about a running agent.
